hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Verify whether the resulting sequence of integer values reads identically backwards and forwards.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Apply converging boundary pointers from opposite ends.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def checkAsciiPalindromic(s: str) -> bool:
    l = 0
    r = len(s) - 1
    while l < r:
        if ord(s[l]) != ord(s[r]):
            return False
        l += 1
        r -= 1
    return True
```
